recent_changes.author: Devin
recent_changes.description: Wiki Generation System: Design Phase Complete
changes: Created comprehensive design spec: docs/specs/wiki_gen_spec.md (19 sections, Mermaid diagrams)
Architecture: Tree-sitter + LLM hybrid pipeline (Phase 0-6)
IR design: Symbol-centric with stable SymbolId (file_path + span + kind)
3-layer Code Graph: FileGraph / SymbolGraph / RuntimeGraph (petgraph)
API Endpoint extraction: OpenAPI/Proto priority > code route > LLM inference
Auth signal extraction: 80% rule (output signals, not conclusions)
Evidence-backed LLM generation: EvidencePack + wiki_index.json traceability
V1 languages: Rust + Python + Java + Vue (TS + HTML)
Dual-path access: CLI (clap) + Gateway API (/v1/wiki/*)
Incremental cache: SHA256 content/prompt hashing
Old Wiki System A marked for deletion (WikiAdapter trait + old S3)
Updated ARCHITECTURE.md, STATUS.md, roadmap, state.json

recent_changes.author: Devin
changes: Security: auth.rs constant-time token comparison via subtle::ConstantTimeEq (prevents timing attacks)
Security: nested routes (graph/multimodal/memory_manage/security) moved under auth middleware
Security: Admin CORS restricted from Any to localhost:3000 default + ADMIN_CORS_ORIGINS env var
Security: RateLimiter memory leak fix (evicts stale IPs when >1000 entries)
Architecture: extract_validated_tenant_id deduplicated to routes/mod.rs shared module
Logic: handlers.rs reads X-User-ID header instead of hardcoded default_user
Logic: handlers.rs eliminates double compliance check (caches first result)
Design: removed duplicate AppError::TooManyRequests variant (unified to RateLimited)
Design: removed emoji from log messages (production-clean logs)
Design: EmbeddingCache evicts half entries instead of clearing all
